name: Checkbox
purpose: A square box the user ticks to choose an option, with its label; it can also show a dash for a partly chosen set (indeterminate). One of the four selection controls (s313-D56); drawn by the Checkbox rows of the Selection-controls reference.

$memberOf.$note: one of the family's four parts; the family meta keeps the catalogue entry, the reference snippet and only the settings all four share; this meta holds this control's spec and its own settings, and is offered for the `input` role beside the family (Dave 2026-10-02 14:55, call 4: 'Yes, each of the four is offered for input')

props.name: label
props.$note: The control's label (reference snippet: 'Email notifications'); absent means no visible label, as the old switch's false did (the control still needs an accessible name). s305-D17 (Dave, #305 call 16, "yes"): a part's own words are a field on the part, not a separate text part inside it, so the gate checks them with the part (length, wrap, the 44px target, the name a screen reader hears). Added #311 lane C0.

variants.name: checkbox
variants.use: Square box; checked/indeterminate fill with reverse check glyph. Supports error + disabled. CLEAN (form/*).

tokens.check-radio-glyph: icon/default-reverse (#fff on filled) / icon/default; disabled icon/disabled
tokens.label: text/default @ font-5 medium (checkbox/radio) / font-6 medium (chip); disabled text/disabled
tokens.$darkDecision-selected-fill: (Dave 2026-06-19) The SELECTED/ON fill (checkbox checked, radio dot, chip selected, switch on) should rebind to the INVERTING secondary/background/default (#000 light / #FFF dark) with the glyph in text/on-inverse (#FFF light / #333 dark) — NOT tertiary/background/active (dark value #1D1D1D is near-black → checked control invisible on the dark page) and NOT icon/default-reverse (flat white → vanishes on the inverted white fill in dark). Same inverting pair that fixed the secondary Button. See snippets/Selection-controls.reference.html.

accessibility.semantics: Use native input semantics (checkbox/radio/switch) with a programmatic label; group radios/checkboxes in a fieldset/role=group with a legend
accessibility.error: Error state pairs rag/error with a text message + aria-invalid, not colour alone (1.4.1)
accessibility.focus: Visible focus outline; controls and their labels are both click targets (44px)
accessibility.$from: the family meta's `accessibility` entries that bear on this control, copied verbatim

antiPatterns: Conveying selected/on by colour alone without a label or check/thumb position
Checkbox/radio without an associated label or group legend
